script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The line says Samson was buried at Zorah, but Judges 16:31 says he was buried between Zorah and Eshtaol.
The moments about the Spirit stirring Samson and Samson’s burial take place between Zorah and Eshtaol, not specifically in Zorah.
Judges 13:2–5 identifies Manoah as a man from Zorah, but does not say exactly where the angel appeared to his wife.

The spies moment says the Danites had no land of their own yet. They had been allotted territory, though Judges 18:1 says they had not yet come into an inheritance. Also, that verse is outside the cited passage.
Judges 18:11–12 tells of the armed Danites’ departure and encampment, but does not say in those verses that they left to take the land the spies had seen. The cited passage could begin at verse 9.
